segments.text: Let's review the pricing page launch.
The pricing page ships on Friday after design signs off.
Marketing wants the annual discount to be twenty percent.
Finance asked us to keep the free tier limited to three seats.
Next topic is hiring for the support team.
We agreed to open two support engineer roles in March.
The interview panel will include Linh and Minh.
Budget for the roles was approved by finance already.
Now the onboarding emails.
The welcome email gets rewritten by Hoa this week.
We will test two subject lines against each other.
The winning subject line is chosen after five hundred sends.
Unsubscribe rates must stay under one percent.
Open rate target is forty percent for the first email.
Next review of the onboarding emails is in two weeks.
Anything else about emails, no, let's move on.
Quarterly infrastructure review starts now.
The database migration to the new cluster happened last weekend.
Downtime was eleven minutes, below the planned thirty.
The backup restore drill failed on the staging replica.
Duc will rerun the restore drill before the end of the month.
We are moving log storage to cheaper object storage.
That change saves about four hundred dollars each month.
Alerting thresholds for disk usage will be lowered to eighty percent.
Security topics are next.
All engineers must enable hardware keys by October.
The password manager rollout is already complete.
A penetration test is booked for the second week of November.
Findings will be triaged within three business days.
Vendor access reviews will happen every quarter.
Linh owns the access review checklist.
That wraps up the infrastructure review.
Welcome to the planning session for the mobile app.
The first release targets iOS and Android together.
Offline mode is the top requested feature from customers.
Push notifications come second in the priority list.
The design team will deliver the new navigation by the twentieth.
Tablet layouts are postponed to the next quarter.
Beta testers will be recruited from the existing customer list.
The beta runs for three weeks before public launch.
Let's discuss analytics for the app.
We track screen views and crash reports only.
No personal data is collected by the analytics events.
Crash reports go to the engineering channel automatically.
The dashboard will be built by Minh next sprint.
We need an app store listing with screenshots.
Hoa will write the store description in both languages.
The release date will be decided after the beta feedback.
